implemented_capabilities.capability: Static Python call-graph extraction with edge-confidence typing (CALLS / MAYBE_CALLS / REFERENCES)
implemented_capabilities.notes: ast-based resolver (imports, class hierarchy, local type inference, module-level aliases) that never imports or executes code; trust level of every edge becomes the relationship type; Flask-style route decorators become public Endpoint nodes; unresolved attribute calls are guessed to at most 6 same-named methods with a stoplist.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph-computed reachability triage (REACHABLE / POSSIBLY_REACHABLE / NEEDS_REVIEW / NO_STATIC_PATH) with persisted witness paths
implemented_capabilities.notes: Cypher shortestPath over (Endpoint)-[:HANDLED_BY]->(Function)-[:CALLS*1..14]->(vulnerable Function); exact-only path gives REACHABLE, adding MAYBE_CALLS/REFERENCES gives POSSIBLY_REACHABLE; verdict is never LLM-decided. Each run persists Run->Finding nodes with path/kinds/layers and EVIDENCE{step} edges, so a proof survives later re-ingest of the app layer.

Deterministic line-text matching of removed/context hunk lines against functions of the vulnerable release ranks candidates; Gemini (optional) picks among candidates, otherwise a labelled 'heuristic' (confidence 0.5) top-scorer is used; curated overrides in data/curated_symbols.json and a cache in data/cache/symbol_map.json make demo runs reproducible. Symbol provenance (source, confidence, rationale, patch_url) is stored on the Vuln.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Snapshot hash of everything a verdict depends on, bound to each Run
implemented_capabilities.notes: SHA-256 (16 hex chars) over package pins, DEPENDS_ON edges + specifiers, per-dist function counts, call-edge counts, all app-layer edges and vulnerable-symbol mappings; stored on (Run).snapshot.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Closed-loop remediation verification in a private scratch graph with gates
implemented_capabilities.notes: Plans version bumps from DEPENDS_ON specifier edges (rejects impossible solo bumps, finds co-upgrades via fixpoint search over PyPI releases), rebuilds the whole graph with candidate pins in a throwaway graph, re-triages, and applies gates (coverage retained >=50%, constraints consistent, exposure decreases, no new exposure) => VERIFIED / REJECTED / UNVERIFIED. Persists a Remediation node BASED_ON the baseline Run.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Evidence-bound human approval: proposed actions with payload hash, tamper check and staleness check
implemented_capabilities.notes: Every Action stores a canonical payload (witness path, content hashes, graph snapshot) and its SHA-256. execute() first verifies the stored payload/body/diff still hash to the approval hash (status 'tampered'), then rebuilds the payload from the CURRENT graph and compares (status 'stale': 'the evidence changed since this action was proposed (changed: ...)'), and only then runs; one executed action per (type,subject); a PR is only proposed if the remediation's baseline_snapshot equals the latest snapshot. Also emits OpenVEX statements and never asserts not_affected from NO_STATIC_PATH.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Gemini function-calling agent whose tools are graph queries, with deterministic offline fallback
implemented_capabilities.notes: Model explains and proposes; verdicts come from Cypher; read-only guard is a regex FORBIDDEN list plus ro_query. LLM_PROMPT_ONLY only for symbol choice and narration. MCP server exposes read tools, remediation planning/verification and propose_fix_pr, but deliberately not execute().

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dependency betweenness (supply-chain chokepoints) and guard-point ranking
implemented_capabilities.notes: CALL algo.betweenness over PackageVersion/Repo DEPENDS_ON edges (FalkorDB-native); guard_points counts app functions that appear on the most witness paths.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Read-only public mode and frozen demo artifacts
implemented_capabilities.notes: Backend-enforced PUBLIC_MODE; ephemeral scratch graphs allowed with a lock and 30 s cooldown; recorded what-if and agent conversations are shipped as static JSON for the public site (recorded, not live).

graph_models_and_cypher: Three layers. Supply chain: Repo, PackageVersion{key,name,version,parsed,direct} with DEPENDS_ON{direct,spec}. Code: Module{layer,dist,file}, Function{qualname,layer,dist,line}, Endpoint{public} with HANDLED_BY, CALLS|MAYBE_CALLS|REFERENCES, DEFINES, PROVIDES, CONTAINS, EXPOSES, Team-OWNS->Module. Advisories: Vuln{id,cve,severity,fixed_version,symbol_source,symbol_confidence,symbol_rationale,patch_url} with AFFECTS and VULNERABLE_SYMBOL{source,confidence}. Results/lineage: Run{id,label,ts,snapshot}-HAS_FINDING->Finding{verdict,path,kinds,layers}-FOR->Vuln, Finding-VIA->Endpoint, Finding-EVIDENCE{step,via}->Function, Remediation{status,result,baseline_snapshot}-BASED_ON->Run, Action{type,subject,status,payload,hash}-RESOLVES->Finding|Remediation, Action-ASSIGNED_TO->Team. Cypher: shortestPath((h)-[:CALLS*1..14]->(f)), UNWIND $rows bulk CREATE, CREATE INDEX FOR (n:L) ON (n.p), CALL algo.betweenness (FalkorDB-native, not Neo4j GDS). Some Cypher is built with f-strings from internal constants (relationship kind, label).
algorithms: Edge-confidence-typed shortestPath (exact CALLS vs CALLS|MAYBE_CALLS|REFERENCES), depth cap 14 (reachable/analysis.py:EXACT_PATH/ANY_PATH)
Static name resolution with local type inference and class-hierarchy method lookup (reachable/callgraph.py)
Patch-hunk line-text overlap scoring to localise the vulnerable function (reachable/symbols.py:candidates)
Constraint-propagating fixpoint planner over DEPENDS_ON specifiers with PyPI release scan, MAX_CANDIDATES 60 (reachable/planner.py:plan_remediation)
Scratch-graph differential re-triage with coverage-ratio gate (reachable/verify.py:verify_plan)
Graph snapshot fingerprint + payload hash tamper/stale check (analysis.py:snapshot_hash, actions.py:execute)
backend_interfaces: MCP stdio server (python -m reachable.mcp_server): list_findings, explain_finding, recommend_fixes, plan_remediation, verify_remediation, supply_chain_hubs, query_graph, propose_fix_pr
No FastAPI/HTTP API; logic is a Python library used by Streamlit and MCP
frontend_interfaces: streamlit_app.py: tabs Triage, Agent, Fix, Actions, Cypher; pyvis witness-path graph; approve/execute buttons gated by PUBLIC mode; target picker (vulnshop demo app, vendored microblog)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Gemini chat with function calling over Toolbox (traces recorded for UI), quota-aware model fallback chain, offline keyword fallback. No conversational memory; durable 'memory' is the graph itself: Runs, Findings, Remediations and Actions are persisted and cross-linked, enabling run-to-run comparison and snapshot-bound approvals.
tests_present: tests/: 9 files, ~49 test functions (test_pipeline 14, test_actions 9, test_callgraph 9, test_verify 5, test_public 4, test_real_repo 4, test_demo 2, test_mcp 1, test_ui 1). Most need a live FalkorDB and/or cached OSV/PyPI data in data/cache; test_real_repo exercises the vendored microblog target. test_actions covers approval, tamper and stale paths.
dependency_requirements: optional gh CLI for filing issues/PRs
security_findings: reachable/actions.py:244,260 - subprocess.run(['gh', ...]) with argv list (no shell) to create issues, branches, commits and draft PRs on GITHUB_REPO; reachable only through execute(), which requires prior human approval and payload-hash/staleness checks

reachable/actions.py:139 - f-string Cypher interpolating link[0] label (internal constant 'Finding' or 'Remediation', not user input); reachable/ingest.py:179 interpolates relationship kind from internal constants; reachable/analysis.py:127 interpolates a fixed clause; reachable/graph.py:37 interpolates fixed label/prop tuples (not injectable)

reachable/agent.py:28-94 - query_graph lets the LLM run arbitrary Cypher; guarded by a regex deny-list (FORBIDDEN) and graph.ro_query (server-side read-only), 25-row cap; regex alone is bypassable but ro_query is the real control; CALL procedures other than db.* are not blocked

reachable/sources.py:33-45 - downloads wheels/sdists from PyPI and extracts them: tarfile uses filter='data' (safe) but zipfile.ZipFile.extractall is used without explicit path validation (Python sanitises member names; no code is executed, only parsed with ast); unrestricted outbound HTTP to pypi.org

reachable/ingest.py:42, advisories.py:36-44, symbols.py:51, planner.py:45 - urllib.request.urlopen to pypi.org, api.osv.dev and github.com commit .patch URLs taken from OSV references (URL host not validated: SSRF-style fetch of attacker-influenced reference URLs ending in /commit/)
reachable/symbols.py:118 and agent.py:166 - GEMINI_API_KEY read from env/.streamlit secrets (config.py:46-48); no hard-coded key; advisory text and diffs are sent to Google
reachable/config.py:15-27 - hand-rolled .env loader and Streamlit secrets flattening into os.environ; secrets.toml.example only
reachable/ingest.py:77-86 - variant edits do str.replace on a temp copy of the target app; no code executed
No eval/exec/pickle; vendored targets/microblog and demo_app/vulnshop are intentionally vulnerable/third-party sample apps (not imported or executed by the engine)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Software dependency vulnerability reachability / blast radius (Software Dependency Intelligence and Security & Vulnerability families); overlaps conceptually with the interdict attack-path triage but at the code-call-graph level; also overlaps SBOM/VEX tooling. Closest relation to Kairos dependency-invalidation ideas.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - approvals are bound to a graph snapshot hash plus a canonical payload SHA-256 and are refused as 'stale' when a rebuild of the current graph no longer reproduces the stored payload ('any change to the evidence expires it'), fixes are only proposed if the remediation's baseline_snapshot equals the latest snapshot, and Run/Finding/Remediation/Action nodes persist witness-path lineage; supersession is implicit (new Run) rather than modelled as edges.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Compact, FalkorDB-native implementation of 'evidence-bound approval': propose -> store hash of derived payload+snapshot -> on approve re-derive from current graph and refuse if different (tampered vs stale), plus scratch-graph what-if verification with explicit pass/fail gates. Directly reusable as the approval-gating and dependency-invalidation core of an Evidence Drift Cascade engine; the Python call-graph extractor and PyPI/OSV planner are an additional dependency-intelligence pack.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (algo.betweenness only for chokepoints); network access to OSV/PyPI/GitHub for ingestion; Gemini key optional; gh CLI optional

strategy_rationale: The payload-hash/stale-check approval gate, snapshot hashing and scratch-graph verification are domain-neutral and should be lifted into Kairos' shared engine; the Python call-graph/OSV/PyPI pipeline can ship as a Software Dependency Intelligence domain pack, with the GitHub-executing path (gh subprocess) left disabled or sandboxed.
